# Sanitized Codex fixtures

These fixtures are schema-shaped examples derived from the documented Codex
hooks and App Server interfaces reviewed in P6-S1. They are not recordings.
They contain placeholders only and must never be replaced with source content,
commands, transcripts, credentials, or real local paths.

The future adapter must discard content-bearing values after extracting
permitted metadata and must not use hook output as a model-visible channel.
